entries.title: Connect Atlassian with one press
entries.body: Settings → Integrations now has Atlassian beside Notion and Linear. Press it and Atlassian's sign-in page opens in your browser; once you finish there, Atlassian's tools appear in its row, each asking you before it runs.

picture.alt: Settings, Integrations, with Atlassian beside Notion and Linear after the MCP server chip
